description: This file defines the ApiClient class, which manages network interactions using the Dio package. It handles HTTP requests with automatic injection of authorization tokens, manages token storage securely, and handles 401 Unauthorized responses by clearing tokens and redirecting users to the login screen.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Singleton class providing HTTP client functionalities with automatic token management and response handling.

methods.name: ApiClient._internal
methods.description: Private constructor initializing Dio with interceptors for token injection and error handling.

methods.name: ApiClient.instance
methods.description: Getter for singleton instance of ApiClient.

methods.name: ApiClient.refresh
methods.description: Reconfigures the Dio base URL after environment variables are loaded.

methods.name: ApiClient._create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new ApiClient with configured Dio and secure storage.

methods.name: setAuthToken
methods.description: Stores the JWT token securely in storage.

methods.name: clearAuthToken
methods.description: Deletes the JWT token from secure storage.

methods.name: _handleUnauthorized
methods.description: Handles 401 errors by clearing token and redirecting to login.
